assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: A 4 by 5 grid of squares with a blue closed route through the centres of all 20 squares: along the top row, snaking through columns 2 to 5 of rows 2 to 4, and back up the first column to the red start square; grey marks show one colour of the chessboard colouring.

difficulty_rationale: Combines a colouring (parity) argument for impossibility with an explicit construction for the even case.
